requirement_text.REQ-070: Replace lib/letflow/router.ex's single flat route table -- today GET /health plus a 404 catch-all, per its own moduledoc -- with the decomposed structure the rest of S4 mounts into. This resolves stage-4-api-surface.md's OQ-1. Framework: Plug/Bandit (REQ-065 addendum 2026-08-20). GET /health preserved byte-compatibly (200+{"status":"ok"}, no auth, no DB). Unmatched routes return REQ-066 RFC 9457 404. Shared middleware chain declared in exactly one place.

task.description:
WF-02 Step 3 — Test design for REQ-070: Router decomposition.

Read lib/letflow/design/req070-router-decomposition.md (the CODE-DESIGNER's test-surface section) and all 12 implementation files.

The existing test file is test/letflow/router_test.exs — read it before writing. Add tests to it (or replace it if the existing tests are now stale post-rewrite); do not create a new test file unless the existing one is structurally incompatible.

Write tests for all 6 acceptance criteria:

AC1 — GET /health with Repo unavailable:
  - Stop/sandbox the Repo so DB calls would fail
  - Call GET /health via Plug.Test
  - Assert status == 200 and body == Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok"})
  - Assert the response is returned even when Ecto.Repo is unavailable
  Approach: In ExUnit, you can assert /health works without calling `Ecto.Sandbox.checkout/1` at all (ExUnit async tests that don't start the DB sandbox). If the existing router tests already use the sandbox, add a new separate test module that does NOT start the sandbox, and in that test confirm /health still returns 200.

AC2 — Sub-router isolation:
  - Mount Letflow.Routers.Identity directly using Plug.Test (call/2 — no top-level router)
  - Issue a GET request to any path under it (e.g. "/some-path")
  - Assert it returns the sub-router's catch-all 404 (RFC 9457 format + Content-Type: application/problem+json)
  - This proves the sub-router compiles and handles calls independently of the top-level router

AC3 — Unrouted path returns RFC 9457 404:
  - Via the top-level router (Letflow.Router): GET /this-path-does-not-exist
  - Assert status == 404
  - Assert Content-Type header includes "application/problem+json"
  - Assert body contains "type", "title", "status", "detail" keys (RFC 9457 shape)
  - Assert body does NOT contain {"error":"not_found"} (the old format)

AC4 — Single middleware declaration site (grep-based):
  - Use File.read!/1 or ExUnit's assertions on file content to verify:
    grep for "Plug.Parsers" across lib/ — must appear in exactly one file (api_pipeline.ex)
    grep for "AuthPipeline" plug call across lib/ — must appear in exactly one file (api_pipeline.ex)
  - Use Path.wildcard or File.ls!/1 to enumerate lib/ recursively and assert match counts
  - This is a code-structure assertion, not a runtime test

AC5 — Moduledoc deferred-route list:
  - Read lib/letflow/router.ex as text (File.read!)
  - Assert all 11 deferred-route names appear in the file content: "dlq", "services", "platform_migrations", "webhooks", "simulation_test", "process_modules", "entities", "entity_query", "agent_requests", "agent_responses", "agent_events"
  - Assert the word "readiness" appears in the file content (for the 'not ported' statement)

AC6 — Moduledoc cites REQ-065 addendum:
  - Read lib/letflow/router.ex as text
  - Assert the string "0001-web-framework.md" appears in the moduledoc
  - Assert the string "2026-08-20" appears in the file (the addendum date)

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Use Plug.Test (`import Plug.Test`) for runtime tests. Call the router with `call(conn, [])` or `Letflow.Router.call(conn, Letflow.Router.init([]))`.
- For AC1: the key is that the test does NOT start Ecto.Sandbox before calling /health. One way: use a test module with `async: true` and no `setup do: Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox.checkout(Letflow.Repo)` — if /health doesn't touch the Repo, it passes.
- For AC3: the 404 body must be the RFC 9457 shape from REQ-066. Verify against the actual Letflow.Api.Error.not_found/0 output by reading lib/letflow/api/error.ex.
- Test file location: test/letflow/router_test.exs (existing file — read it first and extend it, or replace stale tests)
- No DB-dependent tests in this test file — all router tests use Plug.Test (in-memory, no Ecto sandbox needed)

Run mix compile --warnings-as-errors after writing tests to confirm no compilation errors. Compile from the feature branch: feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821.

Toolchain: mix may not be bare on PATH — try bare mix first, then "/c/Program Files/Elixir/bin/mix" if needed.
Do NOT run docker compose up — the Postgres container (letflow-3-postgres-1) is already running on port 5482.

Complete the handoff: status COMPLETED, result.status PASS, artifacts_out listing the test file, next_action 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b)'. Commit the test file and completed handoff on branch feature/WF02-REQ070-20260821 by explicit path.
